metaDescription: SecuEdge protects media houses and content businesses from ransomware, disruption and data theft — with resilient, segmented networks and real-time visibility.

hero.headline: Security for media that never misses a deadline.
hero.sub: Protect content, infrastructure and deadlines from disruption and ransomware — with resilient, segmented networks and real-time visibility across every device.

challenges.title: Ransomware disruption
challenges.desc: Newsrooms and broadcast operations are high-visibility targets where downtime is measured in missed deadlines.

challenges.title: Content & IP theft
challenges.desc: Unreleased content, footage archives and editorial systems hold valuable intellectual property.

challenges.title: Always-on operations
challenges.desc: 24/7 publishing leaves no maintenance window for security incidents.

challenges.title: Distributed teams
challenges.desc: Reporters, stringers and studios connect from everywhere, expanding the attack surface.

capabilities.title: Advanced threat prevention
capabilities.desc: IDS/IPS and antivirus engines detect and block threats in real time.

capabilities.title: Network segmentation
capabilities.desc: VLANs isolate editorial, broadcast and guest networks to contain any incident.

capabilities.title: Real-time visibility
capabilities.desc: Per-device logs — blocked and accessed — exportable for review.

capabilities.title: Secure remote access
capabilities.desc: Site-to-site and remote-access VPN for bureaus and field teams.

cta.headline: Trusted by media houses like Lokmat.
cta.sub: Keep your newsroom online and your content protected.
